scope: Research only; production third suitability unchanged
target: Unique exact third finisher included in third suitability Top5
popularitySubsetDefinition: Denominator is races whose actual third finisher has final popularity >=4 or >=10; not an unconditional race hit rate
notMeasured: Bet ticket hit rate or return on investment
narScoreTransform: Candidate score blends use exponentiated logits as ranking weights; baseline and rank blends preserve logistic ranking. Not the UI sigmoid-share scale.
decision: Keep current third suitability in both leagues: conditional lifts have date-cluster confidence intervals crossing zero and reduce longshot recall.
